summary.summary: Since this morning all our dev pipelines fail with 'resource creation denied' in the cloud sandbox. The whole team is blocked and we cannot deploy anything to test.

suggested_resolution.answer:
The budget limit has likely been reached, and since the whole team is blocked from deploying, this is a P2 issue. 

1. Check the platform status page for any known incidents.
2. Verify the budget status of your cloud sandbox account.
3. If the budget is at 100%, request a budget increase from your team lead with the necessary cost centre.
4. While waiting for approval, consider canceling old jobs if applicable to free up resources.

sources.text:
DEV-002: Cloud Sandbox Accounts and CI/CD Pipeline Issues (synthetic analogue) > Pipeline Failures
1. Check the platform status page first: a known incident means the ticket is linked to it and no further troubleshooting is needed.
2. "No runner available" errors: shared runners are limited to 20 concurrent jobs per team; queue or cancel old jobs.
3. Pipelines failing with "quota exceeded" or "resource creation denied" in the sandbox usually mean the budget limit has been reached.
4. Credential errors in pipelines: rotate the service account secret in the vault; secrets expire every 90 days.

DEV-002: Cloud Sandbox Accounts and CI/CD Pipeline Issues (synthetic analogue) > Priority
A whole team blocked from deploying to the shared test environment is P2. A production deployment pipeline down is P1 and pages the Cloud Platform on-call engineer.

DEV-002: Cloud Sandbox Accounts and CI/CD Pipeline Issues (synthetic analogue) > Sandbox Accounts
- Each team gets one cloud sandbox account with a monthly budget (default equivalent of 1,000 USD).
- At 80% of budget the team lead gets an alert; at 100% new compute resources are blocked automatically.
- A budget increase is requested by the team lead with a cost centre; approval takes 1 business day.
- Sandboxes must not hold production or customer data.

DEV-002: Cloud Sandbox Accounts and CI/CD Pipeline Issues (synthetic analogue) > Overview
Owner: Cloud Platform Team

draft_reply:
Thank you for reporting the issue with your dev pipelines. I have assigned this to the Technical & IT Support team with a priority level of P2. 

To begin resolving this, please check the platform status page for any known incidents and verify the budget status of your cloud sandbox account. If the budget is at 100%, kindly request a budget increase from your team lead with the necessary cost centre. 

Once you’ve completed these steps, the support team will follow up to assist further. We appreciate your patience while we work to resolve this matter.
